notes.title: 'Willow' - First Content Update
notes.notes:
Greetings from the trail, detective!

The Willow version is the first content update for Tamarak Trail 🎲

Listening to your feedback we've added several cores that should change gameplay dramatically (for example removing infinite combo exhaustion for a die!). The balance changes were aimed to shorten the amount of time a run takes (especially the forest area) and make the mines more challenging. 

Dice throwing was improved a bit to add more randomness and rotation. This experimentation will be continued with the increasing mass of the dice in future updates. Talking about the future, the next goal is to improve the diversity of monsters by adding elite monsters guarding chests. 

As this feature touches on map generation and several foundational elements of the game it requires careful thought and testing. 

✨ - Community suggestion

notes.title: Patch Notes - 📫 1.0.1 Spruce
notes.notes:
Hello detectives!

We’ve watched countless hours of streams and videos, talked to the community extensively after launch and we’ve cooked up the first post-launch update of the game. We hear your feedback and so we’re starting to make some of the requested changes - we’ll be adding more reroll charge rewards to the event, balancing monster combat ratings and monster choice algorithm (so you don’t run into ghost dogs fifty million freaking times). We have also gutted the pigeon so it has only one heart left. That’s right - by popular demand, we ripped the heart out of that poor creature. 

Among the most important changes are also nerfs to Scare and by proxy the Ghost area difficulty. The mines and ghost boss fight was found to be a little underwhelming by the community so we’re buffing these a little bit to solve this problem. We also started experimenting with dice physics to make the dice easier to overturn with another die and make them a little bit more bouncy overall. 

Thank you for your feedback and the overwhelming support you’ve shown us during the launch. We appreciate it very much, see you on the Trail!

Check out all our updates and fixes we've made here:

Balance

 Decreased market prices by 10%
 Increased score calculation for ability unlocks for defeated monsters and acquired sides by 30%
 Increased Garmonbozia gain by 1 for each boss
 Added reroll charge rewards to Wounded Horse encounter
 Changed the poison stacks from Wounded Horse from 10 to 5
 Increased the amount of Scare stacks needed to wound hero from 3-4
 Merciless monsters difficulty modifier reduces Scare stacks needed to wound to 3

 Added 5% dice bounciness

Fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes for 10/13/23
notes.notes:
Howdy everyone, you may of noticed a game update is available! We've been working on some balance changes, bug fixes, & more! Here's the full rundown: 

Content Additions:


 Added support tooltips for previously selected event options.
 Added support for using abilities at 0 resolve.
 Introduced new tutorials for controller users.
 Enhanced the UI with SFX in the option menu.
 Added a "Hold" text for passing the turn in combat scenes with a controller.
 Added a white glow on the Hero CP bar when it reaches zero.


Balance Changes:


 SluggardA: Resolve Regeneration changed from 4 to 3.
 SluggardB: Resolve Regeneration changed from 4 to 3, increased multiattack damage from 2 to 4.
 SluggardC: Resolve Regeneration changed from 5 to 3, hearts changed from 7 to 4.
 Badger: Increased basic attack damage from 3 to 4, decreased chance of using a buff.
 Cannon Fodder: Increased basic attack damage from 4 to 5.
 Weasel: Increased attack damage from 5 to 6.
 Moth: Increased attack damage from 4 to 5.
 FootmanA: Decreased chance of using a buff.
 GravelHound: Changed max Resolve from 30 to 25, increased attack damage from 5 to 6.
 Stalagmaw: Increased attack damage from 6 to 7.
 BeetleWeasel: Changed Regeneration from 5 to 3, decreased chance of using a buff, increased basic attack damage from 3 to 4.


Bug Fixes:


 Fixed an issue where the tutorial didn't display controller UI when playing with a joystick on Steam.
 Resolved problems with several encounters that were not implemented in the game.
 Fixed missing description boxes for UI elements in the 'Main Menu,' 'Lodge,' and 'Market' screens.
 Corrected an issue where clicking on the 'Options' menu button caused its animation to get stuck until the player hovered over it again.
 Fixed the absence of UI instructions for pressing and holding the controller button to use the 'End Turn' option.
 Addressed an issue where the option button remained stuck in animation after opening the options.
 Fixed a bug in the first combat tutorial for controllers where some special sprites didn't display.
 Resolved an issue where the game failed to load the next scenario if the player defeated the first phase of 'The Source.'
 Fixed the 'Gunslinger' ability, which was increasing audio for each bullet consumed, causing overwhelming loudness at times.
 Corrected the 'Dice Customization' tutorial, which didn't progress when equipping a 'Core' with a controller.
 Fixed the 'Cold Calculation' ability, which displayed the value of defense applied from its previous use.
 Corrected the blur on Die face 'Abilities' description in the 'Underground Village' shop based on the 'Graphics' resolution.
 Fixed missing translation in the 'Screen Mode' settings strings.
 Added feedback audio when changing the options in the tabs of the 'Options Menu.'
 Fixed localization in the fullscreen mode in the Options.

 Contained Muisak damage to all monsters per bounce reduced (2->1) - further nerf was needed


Fixes:

 Fixed charity in shops (shopkeepers wouldn't take gold)
 Fixed placeholder labels in Options
 Fixed Options not being saved between scenes
 Fixed various sounds not responding to sound settings


During this week we'll monitor the balance situation closely and address any raised issues. We are aware of a display bug concerning the flip indicator and will have it fixed shortly.

We'd like to thank members of the community: Judowiec, Adin, The Games Detective, Undercover Shrimp, Hoodoo, Jujubee, Sanger and Taka who report bugs and actively discuss the game in various channels. Everyone is welcome to drop by our Discord.

notes.title: Demo update available now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, VS Trippi here with a demo update from the Yarrow Games team! The team just finished some changes stemming from weekend's feedback. We focused on fixing bugs, QoL and changes to the pace of the game. We hear your voice and shifted priorities accordingly. Thank you so much for helping us make this demo better!

Content



 New infinite combo animation
 Added new status effect tooltips to Victory UI
 Added the ability to stop targetting ability with right click 



Balance

 Redesigned Phoenix Feather core to make it more useful (gives 15 Resolve back on wound)
 Redesigned Contained Muisak core to make it more reliable (does damage on to all monsters on bounce)
 Redesigned Everfresh Tusk to be more consistent (gives 1 power per exhaust)
 Increased Confusion stacks from Undercover (1-> 3)
 Reduced Rat Resolve regen and stealth stacks per cast (3->2, 2->1)
 Reduced Mosquito Resolve (15 -> 12), increased Mosquito damage (4 -> 6)
 Reduced Moth Resolve Regen (3 -> 2)
 Reduced SluggardB Resolve Regen (6 -> 4)
 Inceased SluggardB damage (10 -> 12)
 Reduced SluggardA Resolve Regen (6 -> 4)
 Increased SluggardA single attack damage (8 -> 10)
 Reduced Sluggard C Resolve Regen (6-> 4)
 Reduced Cannon Fodder (pigeon) max Resolve (15 -> 12)
 Increased Cannon Fodder multiattack damage (3 -> 4)
 Increased Cannon Fodder damage (4 -> 5)
 Mosquito now applies poison only if damage wasn't blocked.
 Increased bounciness of the dice by 10% (we'll probably pump those numbers up further)
 Buffed backflip infinite combo



Fixes


 Fixed dice disappearing in Dice Forge
 Fixed journal UI being not responsive
 Fixed dice inventory not disappearing on defeat
 Fixed Safe House description
 Fixed a bug causing a null reference with Exhaust tutorial
 Fixed a bug causing a null reference with flip visual indicator in Dice Forge
 Fixed Sluggard monster persisting after combat
 Fixed Blind causing unnecesary delay at end of turn
 Fixed not being able to drag the ability near walls


Special thanks to Haszi, Retromation, Pobre Gamer, Karnie, Perih, Rickroll, UndercoverShrimp, Ronin, Noldor, Taka and Vera and many others who helped by giving feedback and engaging with us on various channels.
